#LEGAL

Privacy Policy

(Last Updated: August 17, 2026)

Table of Contents

1. Scope2. Information We Collect3. Data Controller4. How We Use Your Data5. Legal Basis6. Clinical Research Data7. Cookies8. Data Sharing & Transfers9. Data Security & Retention10. Your Rights11. Updates12. Contact

ES-CR is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect information when you interact with our website and services.

1. Scope

This policy applies to personal data collected through our website, clinical research activities, professional services, and business interactions.

2. Information We Collect

Depending on the nature of our interaction, we may collect the following categories of information:

  • Contact details: name, email address, phone number.
  • Professional information: job title, organization, area of expertise.
  • Technical data: IP address, browser type, pages visited.
  • Information related to clinical research activities, where applicable and in accordance with applicable regulations.

3. Data Controller

ES-CR is responsible for the processing of personal data covered by this Privacy Policy.

4. How We Use Your Data

We use personal data to provide our services, manage our business relationships, conduct research activities, communicate with you, improve our website, and meet our legal and regulatory obligations.

5. Legal Basis

Personal data is processed on an appropriate legal basis, such as consent, contractual requirements, legal obligations, or legitimate interests, where applicable.

6. Clinical Research Data

Data related to clinical research is handled in accordance with applicable laws, regulatory requirements, study protocols, and confidentiality obligations.

7. Cookies

Our website may use cookies to ensure proper functionality and improve the user experience. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.

8. Data Sharing & Transfers

Where necessary and permitted by law, data may be shared with trusted service providers, clients, research partners, or competent authorities. Personal data is not transferred outside Algeria unless permitted by applicable data protection laws and subject to the required conditions and safeguards.

9. Data Security & Retention

We take appropriate measures to protect personal data and retain it only for as long as necessary or required by applicable laws and regulations.

Network Security

Secure connections (SSL/TLS) and appropriate network protections are implemented to safeguard data in transit.

Access Control

Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel only, based on their role and responsibilities.

Procedural Measures

Internal data protection policies and staff awareness measures are in place to ensure proper handling of personal data.

Anonymization

Where appropriate, personal data is anonymized or pseudonymized to minimize privacy risks.

10. Your Rights

Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to:

  • ●Be informed about the processing of your personal data.
  • ●Access and correct your personal data.
  • ●Object to the processing of your personal data.
  • ●Exercise other applicable rights under relevant data protection laws.

11. Updates

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this website.
